'''Leonel Felipe Alves Alves''' (born 28 September 1993) is an Andorran professional [[association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[Midfielder|defensive midfielder]].

==Club career==
Alves has played club football for [[UE Santa Coloma|Santa Coloma]], [[FC Andorra]], [[UE Sant Julià|Sant Julià]], and [[FS La Massana|La Massana]].<ref name = "NFT">{{NFT player|id=54984|accessdate=28 September 2014}}</ref><ref>{{Soccerway|leonel-felipe-alves-alves/134799|accessdate=28 September 2014}}</ref>

== International career ==
Alvesif made his international debut for the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]] in 2014.<ref name="NFT" />
